$comment: Rules for scripts/build-skills.mjs. Values on the page are for an unequipped character with no points in other skills; 'stats' sets the stat('…'.accr) values that are not 0 on such a character, and 'baseSkills' are the skills every character has at level 1.
pageNotes: Values assume no items and no points in other skills. Bonuses from synergies are listed under each skill and are not included in the numbers.
Pick a skill level and character level to see the values the game would show. Some skills scale with character level as well as skill level.

tokenAliases.$comment: Formula tokens: a string renames a token (fixes typos in the data), a number pins its value.

descriptions.$comment: From the old site's Mercenary and Oskill Information page, for skills whose numbers depend on other skills. Long Shot's data gives +5% damage per frame flown over 20 frames (+100%), the old page says up to +200%.
descriptions.Dragon Fury Discharge: When it procs, unleashes a fully charged Dragon Fury at the level you have learned (not the proc's level).
descriptions.Execute Discharge: When it procs, unleashes a fully charged Execute at the level you have learned (not the proc's level).
descriptions.Wild Airs of the Elements: A passive that periodically fires Immolation, Freezing and Lightning Arrows at nearby enemies.
descriptions.Long Shot: A missile that deals 100% weapon damage, and more the farther it flies.

otherIntro: Skills that don't belong to a class tree. Items grant them as oskills, as a chance to cast, as charges or as auras, so any class can use them.
